msg: I divided the gnomes by hat colour, red/purple and green/brown.  There would always be one from each set in each round.  If one set was yielding 4 or more mushrooms I tended to stick with it, otherwise I'd switch to the other set.  If switching didn't work, I'd choose randomly for a few rounds until it seemed one side was paying out more, then I'd stick with that and repeat the process.I suspect splitting the gnomes by hat shape may have been a better tactic at times, but I was struggling to track that and the colour at the same time.
